scope: 77-case training-source runtime assay; ready-cohort scheduling only
residence_scope: Each outer call contains the full77 ready cohort; row residence is cohort-call residence, not internal microbatch or online queue latency

protocol.timing: complete cohort cycles, including tokenization, batching, model, host results, decision interpretation and row bookkeeping
protocol.batch_residence: full synchronous batch call latency assigned to each member; excludes admission queue and transport
protocol.memory: OS cumulative process high-water RSS at cycle boundaries; shared loaded engines, cannot attribute per-arm resident memory
protocol.native_synchronization: native scorers materialize host floats; custom engines may supply an explicit barrier
